patch_list: Disables PairIP (com.pairip.licensecheck) verification: no install-source check, no Play licensing bind, no paywall/error dialog and no delayed process exit. Required for sideloaded or re-signed APKs, which PairIP would otherwise close aft…

Makes the app see the original developer certificate instead of the one used to re-sign the APK. Stops the ~2 second anti-tamper process kill (Process.killProcess + System.exit) scheduled from icr.onCreate/onDestroy, prevents the PRO flag…

Unlocks the PRO entitlement: isPro returns true, the free-build/paywall gate returns false, the "Upgrade to PRO" dialog is disabled and the free-version master flag is never set at startup (which also removes the PRO-only placeholders and…
